richiami.difetto: The predetermined break point in the cushion for the side airbags is on the wrong side. In the event of a crash, the side airbag may not inflate properly, thus not provide protection and increase the risk of an injury.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The predetermined break point in the cushion for the side airbags is on the wrong side.
